components.name: CertificationList
components.summary: A ruled list of credentials: name, a hairline that stretches to the right, and the year in an aligned column.

components.name: GroupLabel
components.summary: A small sentence-case label above a group of items, currently used only above the certification list ("Pega Certifications").

components.name: JobEntry
components.summary: One role in the work history: an employer mark in a round disc, then the company, a large lowercase title, dates and place, and one sentence of description.

components.name: PhotoCaption
components.summary: The row under the About photo, with external links on the left and the current photo's place · country on the right.

components.name: PillButton
components.summary: A 38px round control for global toggles (language, theme) that holds a short lowercase label or a 16px icon.

components.name: ProjectItem
components.summary: A project link with an arrow-out icon and a one-line description underneath.

components.name: PulseDot
components.summary: A small focus-coloured disc with a ring that grows and fades on a loop.

components.name: SideNav
components.summary: A right-aligned, vertically centred stack of lowercase section links that highlights the section being read.

components.name: Wordmark
components.summary: The type-only logo: "lwc" in lowercase DM Sans 500 at 22px, which unfolds into "lewis william christie" on hover.
